rules: development: may be used for any tuning, prompt design, threshold calibration and debugging.

validation_contaminated: used during development of the intent router (commit edd37e3) and contextual reranking (commit 17c4b2e); report it as a development-contaminated validation set, never as an independent blind test.
blind_test: never used for tuning models, prompts or thresholds. Metrics may be computed only after human labels are frozen (frozen=true and the label file hash matches labels_sha256).

development.label_provenance: UNRECORDED: no annotator identity, date or agreement data in the repository

validation_contaminated.label_provenance: UNRECORDED: evaluation/README.md describes separate assessors, but no annotator records exist

blind_test.status: queries written; NOT LABELLED; metrics NOT EVALUATED until frozen
